name: How long does weather-protective exterior paint last?

mainEntity.name: How long does weather-protective exterior paint last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of weather-protective exterior paint typically ranges from 7 to 15 years, but this can vary based on several decision factors, including the quality of the paint product, the thoroughness of surface preparation, and local weather conditions. For homes in the DFW area, intense sun exposure and occasional severe weather can accelerate wear, making high-quality paint and proper application critical for maximum durability. Regular maintenance, such as cleaning, can also contribute to the paint's lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Weather-protective exterior paint typically lasts 7-15 years, depending on paint quality, surface preparation, and local weather conditions, especially in the DFW area.
